description: This file is a shell script used for testing the functionality of exclude_patterns in git's reference store. It sets up test cases, defines helper functions, and runs assertions to verify correct behavior when excluding certain reference regions in git.

methods.name: for_each_ref__exclude
methods.description: Runs 'test-tool ref-store main --for-each-ref--exclude' with given patterns, outputs ref names after exclusions.

methods.name: for_each_ref
methods.description: Lists references matching given refs, formatted with refname.

methods.name: assert_jumps
methods.description: Checks if the trace output contains expected jump count based on ref format.

methods.name: assert_no_jumps
methods.description: Verifies that no jumps are present in the trace output.
